findings.issue: `signedPointTwistEquiv` is presented as functoriality of the twist, but the file states neither functor law: no identity lemma and no composition lemma. Transporting an identification along successive twists in step (δ) therefore requires unfolding the definition.

summary: The new diffeomorphisms export only their forward-map lemma, with no inverse counterpart, and the twist functor has no identity or composition laws, so downstream assembly (δ) would have to unfold definitions.
